toad.name: Mire toadling
toad.blurb: Hops after you and croaks at danger.

fox.name: Ember fox kit
fox.blurb: A fox cub with a tail that glows like coals.

owl.name: Snow owl
owl.blurb: Rides on your shoulder, turns its head right round, and hoots at night.

drake.name: Baby dragon
drake.blurb: Tiny, fierce, and breathes little sparks.

parrot.name: Tidewake parrot
parrot.blurb: Squawks, flaps and repeats rude pirate words.

pumpkin_slime.name: Pumpkin slime
pumpkin_slime.blurb: A Harvest Fair slime. Smells faintly of pie.

lantern_owl.name: Lantern owl
lantern_owl.blurb: A golden owl that glows softly on Lantern Nights.

snow_fox.name: Snow fox kit
snow_fox.blurb: A Winter Feast fox, white as fresh snow.

bee.name: Honey bee
bee.blurb: A bee the size of a cat. It buzzes round your head and never stings you.

rock_golem.name: Rock golem
rock_golem.blurb: A little golem of mossy stone with blue crystals on its shoulders. Slow, steady, and very hard to hurt.

shadow_cat.name: Night prowler
shadow_cat.blurb: A black cat with violet runes in its fur. It steps through shadows and is at your enemy's throat before they see it.

spirit_wisp.name: Spirit wisp
spirit_wisp.blurb: A glowing ball of blue spirit-fire with trailing tendrils. It hums when you are hurt.

phoenix_chick.name: Flame hatchling
phoenix_chick.blurb: A phoenix chick with a flaming crest. Too small to be reborn yet, but it is working on it.

spell_book.name: Spellbook
spell_book.blurb: A living spellbook that flies on its covers, pages riffling. A mage's companion: it snaps shut on anything that comes too close.

horse.name: Chestnut horse
horse.blurb: Steady, fast and cheaper than new boots.

destrier.name: Armored destrier
destrier.blurb: A barded warhorse with a golden crest.

direwolf.name: Frost dire wolf
direwolf.blurb: Bred in Highcairn. Runs on snow like it is road.

raptor.name: Island raptor
raptor.blurb: Tamed on Dragonscale Isle. The fastest thing with legs.

goldsteed.name: Goldhorn steed
goldsteed.blurb: A golden horse from Goldhorn’s herd. Rare drop.

nightmare.name: Mistfang nightmare
nightmare.blurb: A ghost-black horse with burning violet eyes. Rare drop.

bogstrider.name: Bogstrider
bogstrider.blurb: A swamp lizard that runs on mud like it is road. Rare drop.

glacierwolf.name: Glacier wolf
glacierwolf.blurb: Rimeclaw’s pup, grown huge and loyal. Rare drop.

dunestrider.name: Dunestrider
dunestrider.blurb: A sand-gold runner from the deep desert. Rare drop.

tidelizard.name: Tidecrest runner
tidelizard.blurb: Coral-crested and fast as a wave. Rare drop.

emberlizard.name: Emberback runner
emberlizard.blurb: Obsidian scales, lava in its veins. Rare drop.

voidwing.name: Voidwing
voidwing.blurb: A winged steed of the starless sky. Almost nobody has one.

gladiator.name: Gladiator’s warhorse
gladiator.blurb: Earned in the arena by heroes rated 1800 or higher.

phoenix.name: Ashen Phoenix
phoenix.blurb: A great bird of living flame, reborn from its own ashes. The fastest mount in the realm.

fossilraptor.name: Fossilized raptor
fossilraptor.blurb: An old island raptor of bare bone, dug up in the Fossil Lands and walking again. One treasure dig in a hundred.

snail.name: Wandering snail
snail.blurb: A saddled giant snail, packs and bedroll and all. Slow and steady, they said. They were wrong.

warg.name: Ashen warg
warg.blurb: A great black wolf with ember eyes and a spiked iron collar, broken to the saddle (mostly).

mammoth.name: Tusked mammoth
mammoth.blurb: A woolly giant with a saddle on its hump. You see the whole world from up there.

spider.name: Ashen widow
spider.blurb: A giant cave spider under a red silk blanket and an ember-stone saddle. Eight legs never stumble.

timberwolf.name: Timber dire wolf
timberwolf.blurb: A huge grey wolf with a night-blue saddle. Runs all day and howls at the moon.

magmahound.name: Magma hound
magmahound.blurb: A hound of cooling lava, cracked with fire. Its saddle smokes a little.

ashwing.name: Ashwing drake
ashwing.blurb: A grey wyvern that walks on its wings, and takes to the air when you ride it hard. Roars when it is happy, which is rarely.

firebird.name: Sunfire phoenix
firebird.blurb: A great bird of flame-red feathers that carries you just above the ground.

souleater_red.name: Crimson soul-eater
souleater_red.blurb: A squat red dragon with a mouth full of teeth and a saddle between its wings.

souleater_green.name: Moss soul-eater
souleater_green.blurb: A squat green dragon from the deep marsh, saddled for war.

souleater_blue.name: Azure soul-eater
souleater_blue.blurb: A squat blue dragon that smells of rain and lightning.

souleater_black.name: Onyx soul-eater
souleater_black.blurb: A squat black dragon with a red saddle. Nobody argues with you.

tyrant.name: Tyrant Alpha
tyrant.blurb: A rebuilt king of the old lizards, black and violet, with machine bones under its scales.

knight.name: Sir Aldric
knight.blurb: Taunts enemies onto himself and soaks the hits.

ranger.name: Wren
ranger.blurb: Fires arrows from range at whatever you fight.

cleric.name: Sister Mae
cleric.blurb: Heals you and the party, and smites with holy bolts.

kael.name: Kael the Ember Monk
kael.blurb: Last of the Ember order. His blows burn, and he never leaves a friend behind.

PET_SKILLS: brings back extra coins from every kill
sometimes finds an extra material when you gather
rare drops turn up more often
